scenario.topic: Decide on a defensive formation for the amateur football team

options.name: 4-3 Defensive Formation
options.upside: Provides solid run defense with flexible pass coverage.
options.concern: May struggle against very fast passing offenses due to limited defensive backs.

options.name: 3-4 Defensive Formation
options.upside: Increases linebacker involvement for varied blitz and coverage options.
options.concern: Requires linebackers with good tackling skills to compensate for fewer linemen.

options.name: Nickel Defense Formation
options.upside: Adds an additional cornerback to improve pass defense.
options.concern: Reduces linebacker presence, potentially weakening run defense.

options.name: 5-2 Defensive Formation
options.upside: Strengthens defensive line to better stop running plays.
options.concern: Less flexible in pass coverage due to fewer linebackers and defensive backs.
